scope: Standing Gibran Museum in the former cliffside Mar Sarkis monastery at Bsharri, Lebanon, including the valley-facing arcaded entry, stepped stone volumes and terrace edge.
representedDate: Standing monastery and twentieth-century museum extensions, using the southwest photograph uploaded in 2006 and present mapped footprint.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The operator identifies the Mar Sarkis hermitage, monastery and tomb. Museum construction restored existing rooms and added the eastern wing beginning in 1975.
Municipality documents the valley of the saints location, 1975 eastern wing and further work in 1995 and 2003.
